goal.zh: 浏览与维护同济网论坛，将 Discuz 历史内容接入新的社区界面。

role.zh: 应用、共享包与迁移工具

论坛 API 与定时任务

role.zh: 论坛密码登录与后台 Google 会话

passed: four documents: relative links, images and README section order
bilingual shell examples, bash syntax and script references
isolated local D1 initialization from all unchanged Worker migrations
current forum and admin domains verified from release workflow; MIT license verified
frozen workspace dependency installation with normal Husky preparation
normal pre-commit: staged lint, all configured coverage checks, staged secret scan, isolated HTTP Worker tests
normal pre-push: typecheck, lint, coverage, Bun unit cases, local HTTP tests, JS/Rust dependency scans and secret scan
GitHub contents API exact-byte readback for Chinese and English README at published commit
clean main with origin/main in sync after push
CI and Release succeeded; both Docker sites passed workflow smoke checks
notRun: browser suites locally; CI browser checks passed
development servers, real Cap, Google OAuth or email verification
historical community data migration or production data writes
limitations: TUI covers browsing, local filtering and login; it has no post/reply actions.
Fresh configuration needs distinct forum/admin keys, Cap for web login and Dove for email verification.
Browser runners share local Worker state and the admin runner uses development port 7032.
Browser tests bypass the Cap UI and inject admin sessions; they do not verify Google OAuth or real mail delivery.
Historical docs retain outdated domains, CLI configuration and remote-test instructions; the new development guide identifies current entry points.

deployment.mechanism: Release workflow deploys forum and admin Docker sites after main CI succeeds
